description: Run the pi coding agent entirely inside VS Code — no terminal or browser. Every conversation is a full editor tab, not a sidebar panel, so you can split, compare and keep sessions side by side with your code.

title: PIC-MDF

Config bits, EEPROM, disassembly and a serial monitor
